claim: DNA is transcribed to RNA and translated to protein.
DNA bases pair A-T and G-C.
A codon is three nucleotides specifying an amino acid or stop.
CRISPR is a bacterial adaptive immune system later adapted as a programmable nuclease.
Cas9 cuts DNA at a site specified by a guide RNA next to a PAM.
Prime editing writes short edits without a double-strand break or donor template.
Base editors convert one base to another without a double-strand break.
mRNA carries the coding sequence from nucleus to ribosome.
Introns are removed and exons joined to form mature mRNA.
Methylation and histone marks change expression without changing sequence.
GWAS associates common variants with traits in populations.
Segregation and independent assortment describe inheritance of discrete factors.
PCR amplifies a DNA segment using primers and a polymerase.
Sequencing reads the order of nucleotides in a molecule.
Homologous genes share ancestry and can be aligned.
Selection changes allele frequencies when variants affect reproductive success.
CRISPR nucleases can cut sites similar to the intended target.
Editing components must reach the target cell. Delivery is a separate problem from cutting.
